data.exact_reserve_text: There was an improvement in prior years of $23.3m (2015: $52.6m).
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 780 closed 2016 with a net release on prior years. The technical reserves note records an improvement in prior years of $23.3m, driven by favourable claims development (and associated reinsurance recoveries) on earlier underwriting years. This resulted in an overall release relative to opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: There was an improvement in prior years of $23.3m (2015: $52.6m).
data.data_quality_notes: Key reserve figures extracted from the Technical Provisions / Claims movement tables (pages ~26-29). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the technical reserves reconciliation (opening balance = 345.2) and the movement in prior years explicitly stated as an improvement of $23.3m. Documentation is in USD millions. Some tables on the scanned pages are low-resolution; segmental premium breakdowns and a fully numeric claims development triangle exist in the report images but could not be confidently OCR-extracted for every cell. Therefore premium totals, LOB-level movements and a complete claims triangle have been left null/empty rather than risk incorrect numeric extraction.
